blocks.tamil_translation: When it is said to you, “Make room (by sitting closer),” then make room; Allah will make room for you (in Jannah); and when it is said (in a gathering), “Rise up,” then rise up; Allah raises by many degrees those of you who believe and those who have been given (religious) knowledge - and Allah is well aware of what you do.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Do not mix the truth with falsehood while you know (it); nor conceal the truth.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَتَاْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبِرِّ وَتَنْسَوْنَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ تَتْلُونَ الْكِتبَ ؕ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Do you command (other) people to do good while you forget yourselves, even though you recite the Scripture (the Tawrat)? Do you not then understand (this)?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَي مَا أَنْهكُمْ عَنْهُ ط۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (So) I do not wish to oppose you by (doing myself) what I forbid you from.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَثَلُ مَا بَعَثَنِيَ اللهُ مِنَ الْهُدَي وَالْعِلْمِ كَمَثَلِ الْغَيْثِ الْكَثِيرِ أَصَابَ أَرْضاً فَكَانَ مِنْهَا نَقِيَّةٌ
